findings.description: The governance half of this chunk adds a new CLI surface to tools/review_phase.py (--chunk, --scope-evidence, chunk-bound records, the rubric/decision fields) but FiveCategoryReviewTests only covers gate thresholds, category fabrication and chunk destination naming. Nothing exercises review_phase.py:263 (chunk requires the rubric and cannot advance), :309-310 (chunk reviews require scope evidence), :316-319 (scope-evidence paths must exist inside the repository after resolution), or verify_record's chunk binding at :205-208 (a chunk record must carry its chunk name and cannot be verified as a phase record). grep for 'chunk' in the test file returns only lines 305-312 and 353-360, so the orchestration branch that produced this very review is untested.
findings.required_fix: Extend FiveCategoryReviewTests with a temporary-repo orchestration test mirroring test_live_new_rubric_record_and_snapshot that runs main(['--phase','19','--chunk','regression-and-governance','--scope-evidence','source.rs']) and asserts: the record contains chunk/rubric/decision, verify_record(root, path, 19, source, 'regression-and-governance') is True while verify_record(..., chunk=None) and a mismatched chunk name are False, '--chunk x --advance' and '--chunk x' without --scope-evidence raise ValueError, and a scope-evidence path resolving outside the repository is rejected.

findings.description: The generated compatibility report prints a raw Python dict repr into published Markdown: "Format occurrences across the strict vendor response trees are {'rfc3339': 56, 'uuid': 124, 'duration': 4}". This comes from the f-string interpolation of s['formatOccurrences'] at tools/g25_report.py:118. This document is the reader-facing artifact the 0.2.2 patch is meant to ship, so leaking interpreter syntax is a delivery-quality defect in the chunk's own documentation deliverable.
findings.required_fix: In tools/g25_report.py:118, render the occurrence counts as explicit Markdown (for example ', '.join(f'`{k}` {v}' for k, v in sorted(s['formatOccurrences'].items())) or a small table) and regenerate docs/G25_COMPATIBILITY.md with python3 tools/g25_report.py.

findings.description: The accepted plan (docs/g25-response-compatibility-plan.md:98-99) requires that union branches and nullable values have branch-valid witnesses and that unreachable branches be recorded rather than silently skipped. walk() and sample() both skip ZodNull union variants with a bare `continue`/filter and nothing records the skip: grep for 'unreachable' across tools/ and docs/G25_COMPATIBILITY.md returns no matches, and cases.json carries no skipped-branch inventory. Effective coverage is preserved by the per-property type:null mutations, so this is a traceability gap rather than a coverage hole.
findings.required_fix: Emit an explicit record (for example a 'skippedBranches' list in cases.json, each with root, path, node and reason='null-branch-covered-by-type:null') and assert its shape in tools/test_g25_generation.py, or state the deliberate deviation in docs/G25_COMPATIBILITY.md.

findings.description: rust_bindings() invokes str(pathlib.Path.home()/'.cargo/bin/rustfmt') unconditionally, unlike tools/generate_models.py:1070 and tools/red_team_dataplane.py:716 which use shutil.which('rustfmt') with the home path only as a fallback. Because `python tools/g25_fixtures.py --check` is a phase-19 gate command (tools/check_phase.py:74) and will be wired into the release CI matrix in phase 20, a host or container with rustfmt on PATH but not under ~/.cargo/bin fails the gate for environmental reasons.
findings.required_fix: Replace the hardcoded path with shutil.which('rustfmt') or str(pathlib.Path.home()/'.cargo/bin/rustfmt'), matching tools/generate_models.py:1070.

findings.description: Phase advancement consults only the phase-level review record and docs/checks; it never reads the per-phase 'chunks' entries in docs/phase-status.json (lines 3771-3784) nor requires an accepted docs/reviews/phase-19-chunk-*.json for each chunk. A phase could therefore be advanced with no chunk review recorded at all, even though the plan's maintainer update states that each chunk and phase receives its own actual review with all five scores.
findings.required_fix: When uses_rubric(phase) and the phase declares chunks, require each chunk to have a verifiable accepted review record (verify_record with that chunk name, decision in {accepted, accepted_with_deficiencies}) before setting status complete in main(), and record the accepted chunk totals in the chunk entries.

findings.description: outcomes.json is coupled to cases.json purely by array position (the Rust test and tools/test_g25_generation.py only zip the two arrays after an equal-length assertion) and records no digest of the corpus it was derived from, unlike contracts/compatibility/g25/comparison.json which binds auditSha256 (tools/g25_report.py:64). Misalignment is currently caught only because both --check commands are in the same gate.
findings.required_fix: Include a casesSha256 of contracts/compatibility/g25/cases.json in the outcomes.json envelope and assert it in crates/scm-sdk/tests/g25_response_compatibility.rs before zipping the arrays.
